operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the small nonabelian converse sweep as ledger 1277
operations.body: Ledger 1277 attacks rather than assumes the arbitrary-nonabelian converse. Every automorphism of S3, D8, and Q8 (38 total) was tested through n=12 on every cyclic-action fiber. All 456 cases and 71,664 exact checks match gcd(n,exp K*exp M)=1; no visible action prime survives every fiber. This is bounded evidence, not a universal proof. The precise falsifier remains a faithful action with a shared visible prime but all twisted fibers bijective. No ring Adams, physical chain transfer, or build is claimed.
